projects.name: Strategic Planning Project
projects.source: Appendix A of the MGMT 4009 syllabus - a team assignment, not individual

items.label: Report section 2: vision, mission, and goals analysis
Report section 3: SWOT analysis - your own research, not lifted from the internet
Report section 4: unique aspects of the company that influence its strategy
Report section 5: current strategies and strategic position, using course terminology
Report section 6: strategic recommendations, specific enough to act on
Report section 7: citations and reference list
Formatting check: Times New Roman 12, single-spaced, 1-inch margins, 5+ pages (excl. title/reference pages)
Every team member's name is in the header of every page
Saved/submitted as MS Word (.docx), not PDF
All acronyms spelled out on first use
File named 'SPP-Last name of each person in the group'
Submitted electronically through Canvas before the deadline
Presentation rehearsed - must fill the full 15-20 minutes
Business formal dress planned for presentation day
Peer evaluation of team members completed near end of term
